item.title: 'Great news for Alabama': Randall Jones confirmed to the Tennessee Valley Authority Board
item.description: A co-owner of a Guntersville insurance agency has been confirmed as a member of the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) board of directors. On Wednesday evening, Randall Jones of Guntersville was approved by the U.S Senate for the role in a 53-43 vote.Jones previously served on the Guntersville Electric Board, where he oversaw a $12.8 million system expansion while keeping debt low. item.title: ABC Board passes emergency hemp rules over sponsor’s opposition
item.description: The ABC Board approved emergency hemp rules at its Thursday meeting, which take effect in January.The rules passed 2-1, with John Knight, a board member, opposing over process concerns. The rules were related to a law passed by state lawmakers in the previous session regulating what hemp products can be sold and creating new fines.State Rep.
